input.quote: 7.2 The O&M Costs as defined in Paragraph 6 shall be borne by the Parties in the proportions set forth in Schedule B.
input.rationale: Subparagraphs 7.1 and 7.2 bind us to bear our Schedule B share of Capital Costs and O&M Costs, and Subparagraph 18.1 locks that funding obligation in for an initial period of at least twenty-five (25) years, terminable only \"at the end of the Initial Period or any time thereafter by giving not less than one (1) year's prior notice\" and with \"No credit for capital costs\" on exit. That is a multi-year, uncapped spend commitment with no in-term reduction or termination right, which falls into walk-away territory under this rule; the upgrade protections in 13.2/14.1 (\"no Party shall be forced to participate in such an upgrade\") do not limit the recurring O&M commitment. We have taken the fallback: a single new Subparagraph 7.2A limiting our O&M Costs commitment to the then-current twelve (12) month period and making it reducible on thirty (30) days' notice. The true-up element is already satisfied by Subparagraph 7.7 (actual-cost adjustments, bills or refunds so each Party bears its proper share); default reclamation of capacity under Paragraph 23 is addressed under the liquidated-damages rule and is not flagged twice here.

mappings.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.
mappings.quote: the amount of each Party's share of the Capital Costs shall be computed by the CBP who shall make appropriate adjustments and render any necessary bills or arrange for any necessary refunds by way of final settlement in order that each Party may bear its proper share of the costs as provided in this Paragraph 7

proposal.summary: Add Subparagraph 7.2A limiting Teleglobe's O&M Costs commitment to the current 12-month period, reducible on 30 days' notice
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot take a 25-year, uncapped O&M funding commitment with no reduction right, so we have added Subparagraph 7.2A limiting Teleglobe USA Inc.'s O&M Costs commitment to the then-current twelve (12) month period and making it reducible on thirty (30) days' notice. Actual-cost true-up already operates under Subparagraph 7.7.

ops.text: Teleglobe USA Inc.'s commitment to bear O&M Costs under Subparagraph 7.2 is limited to the then-current twelve (12) month period and may be reduced by Teleglobe USA Inc. on thirty (30) days' prior written notice.
